## Summary

Describe the externally observable outcome and the implementation phase it belongs to.

## Canonical contract

- [ ] I read `CONTEXT.md` and the relevant canonical specification sections.
- [ ] This change preserves every affected non-negotiable invariant.
- [ ] Any accepted product-decision change includes an ADR and updates the decision log.

## Validation

- [ ] Format, lint, typecheck, and tests pass.
- [ ] macOS, Windows, and Linux impact was assessed.
- [ ] Relevant denial, restart, duplicate-delivery, and partial-failure cases are covered.
- [ ] Credentials, runtime state, generated artifacts, and Device Knowledge stay outside the
      checkout.

## Release notes

- [ ] The PR title and summary are suitable for generated release notes.
- [ ] User-visible or operational changes include documentation in the same change.
- [ ] This is internal-only and needs no user-facing release note.
